sentence: Only 5 students suffered slight injuries, despite the current figures of 7 killed and over 200 injured in the disaster area at large.
translation: 尽管目前的数据显示整个灾区已有 7 人遇难、200 多人受伤，但（这个班）只有 5 名学生受了轻伤。
analysis: despite + 名词短语表让步（介词，不接从句）| the figures of 7 killed and over 200 injured：数字 + 过去分词的独立结构（= 7 people were killed and over 200 were injured 的压缩）——伤亡数据的新闻标准写法 | at large 整个、总体上（the disaster area at large 整个灾区；后置修饰）| Only 5... slight injuries 与 7 killed/200 injured 的强烈对比——把“奇迹”放在“惨烈”的背景板上，新闻导语的对比手法 | suffer injuries 受伤（suffer + 不良名词）
pattern: Only + 数字 + suffered + N, despite + the figures of + 数字 + V-ed and + 数字 + V-ed + at large
imitationCn: 尽管整个赛区共有十几人中暑退赛，我们队只有一人出现轻微不适。
imitationHint: Only one member of our team felt slightly unwell, → despite the figures of over a dozen dropping out from heatstroke in the competition area at large
imitationAnswer: Only one member of our team felt slightly unwell, despite the figures of over a dozen dropping out from heatstroke in the competition area at large.

sentence: There were loud crashes of glass breaking and things falling to the ground, but the students remained still and waited calmly and quietly.
translation: 只听见玻璃碎裂、东西落地的阵阵巨响，但学生们保持不动，安静沉着地等待着。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：glass breaking and things falling 为动名词的复合结构——breaking/falling 作 of 的宾语，glass/things 是它们的逻辑主语（逻辑主语是物用普通格；是人可用所有格：his telling me / him telling me）| crash 巨响、破裂声（loud crashes of... 阵阵巨响）| but 转折出画面对比：环境的轰响 vs 学生的静止——remained still（remain + 形容词保持状态）+ calmly and quietly 双副词 | 灾难叙事的“声静对照”：响得越真，静得越显训练有素
pattern: There were + N + of + 名词 + V-ing and 名词 + V-ing, but + S + remained + adj.
imitationCn: 外面是风声呼啸、树枝折断的巨响，但船员们保持镇定，有条不紊地各就各位。
imitationHint: There were loud roars of wind howling and branches snapping, → but the crew remained calm and took their positions in good order（动名词复合结构）
imitationAnswer: There were loud roars of wind howling and branches snapping, but the crew remained calm and took their positions in good order.

sentence: The moment the shaking stopped, Miss Brown sensed it was the best time for the class to make their escape.
translation: 晃动一停止，布朗老师立即意识到这是全班逃生的最佳时机。
analysis: 课件专项：The moment 用作连词引导时间状语从句，“一……就……”（= as soon as）；同族：the instant/second/minute | 课堂拓展“一……就”全家桶：On/Upon doing、Immediately/Instantly/Directly + 从句、No sooner... than.../Hardly... when...（后两者置句首要部分倒装：Hardly had we got into the theatre when the concert began.）| sense (that)... 感觉到、意识到（凭直觉判断）| it was the best time for sb to do：for 短语点明动作执行者 | make one's escape 逃生（= escape，名词化更书面）
pattern: The moment + 从句, S + sensed + (that) it was the best time for + sb + to V
imitationCn: 雨一停，队长就意识到这是全队冲顶的最佳时机。
imitationHint: The moment the rain stopped, the captain sensed → it was the best time for the team to make their push for the summit
imitationAnswer: The moment the rain stopped, the captain sensed it was the best time for the team to make their push for the summit.

sentence: She signalled to her students to exit the classroom in an orderly line covering their heads with their hands.
translation: 她示意学生们双手护头、排成整齐的一列走出教室。
analysis: signal to sb to do sth 示意某人做某事（signal 不及物 + to sb；课堂拓展：signal that... 示意/标志、signal the beginning/end of 标志开始/结束）| exit 作动词“离开”（exit the classroom；也可 exit via/through）| in an orderly line 状语“排成整齐一列”（orderly 是形容词：有秩序的）| covering their heads with their hands 现在分词作伴随状语——动作的三要素（怎么出、排什么队、手放哪）一句装完，指令性描写的信息密度示范 | 无一字恐慌，全是程序——与上句“训练有素”呼应
pattern: S + signalled to + sb + to V + in + N + V-ing ...（伴随分词）
imitationCn: 教练示意队员们弯着腰、排成一列纵队快速通过烟雾区。
imitationHint: The coach signalled to the players to pass through the smoke zone in a single file, → bending low（伴随分词）
imitationAnswer: The coach signalled to the players to pass through the smoke zone in a single file, bending low.

sentence: After a roll call confirmed that all were safe and sound, they relaxed, laughing, crying and hugging each other.
translation: 点名确认所有人安然无恙后，他们才放松下来——笑着、哭着、互相拥抱着。
analysis: After 从句主语是 a roll call（点名）——无生命名词作主语 + confirm that 宾语从句，“点名证实了……”的物称表达 | safe and sound 安然无恙（头韵习语；类似 full and frank）| 主句 they relaxed 后三个现在分词并列：laughing, crying and hugging——情绪的三重释放，泪与笑并置正是劫后余生的真实 | 分词放句末让“放松”先落地、细节随后铺开——先总后分的动作描写 | confirm 课堂拓展：confirm one's doubts 证实疑虑、It has been confirmed that 据证实
pattern: After + 无生命主语 + confirmed that ..., S + relaxed, V-ing₁, V-ing₂ and V-ing₃
imitationCn: 成绩单证实全员过线后，教室里沸腾了——有人欢呼，有人落泪，有人相拥而泣。
imitationHint: After the score list confirmed that everyone had passed, the classroom burst into life, → some cheering, some weeping and some hugging each other
imitationAnswer: After the score list confirmed that everyone had passed, the classroom burst into life, some cheering, some weeping and some hugging each other.

sentence: It immediately occurred to her that these were signs of an approaching tsunami.
translation: 她立刻意识到，这些是海啸即将来袭的征兆。
analysis: It occurred to sb that...：“某人（突然）想到……”——it 形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句；课堂同义替换：It hit/struck her that... / It crossed her mind that... | occur 三注意（课件强调）：① 不及物，无被动 ② 双写 r（occurred/occurring，同族 preferred/referred）③ occur to 的 to 是介词 | signs of an approaching tsunami：approaching 现在分词作定语“正在逼近的”| these 回指上文异象（海水退去等）——先写现象再写顿悟，灾难叙事“伏笔+点破”的节奏 | 这一“顿悟句式”是读后续写心理转折的万能句
pattern: It immediately occurred to + sb + that + these were signs of + N
imitationCn: 他猛然想到，这些细节正是老师反复提醒过的陷阱。
imitationHint: It suddenly occurred to him that → these details were exactly the traps his teacher had repeatedly warned about
imitationAnswer: It suddenly occurred to him that these details were exactly the traps his teacher had repeatedly warned about.

sentence: To her great relief, the officer immediately realized the coming danger.
translation: 令她大为宽慰的是，那位官员立刻意识到了即将到来的危险。
analysis: To one's (great) relief 令某人（大为）宽慰的是——“to one's + 情感名词”句首状语家族：to my surprise/delight/disappointment（与必修二 U2 的 to my satisfaction 插入语同源，此处置句首）| relief 课堂多义：宽慰（a sigh of relief 松一口气）/ 减轻（pain relief）/ 救济（disaster relief 赈灾、relief supplies 救灾物资——本单元主题词）| the coming danger：coming 现在分词作定语“即将到来的”（= approaching）| 叙事功能：报信人最怕不被相信——一个 relief 写出“被听见了”的如释重负
pattern: To one's great relief, S + immediately + V + the coming + N
imitationCn: 令他如释重负的是，裁判立刻理解了他的手势。
imitationHint: To his great relief, the referee immediately understood → his gesture
imitationAnswer: To his great relief, the referee immediately understood his gesture.

sentence: Remember to inform yourself of what is going on.
translation: 记得随时了解事态的进展。
analysis: inform yourself of...：反身代词的妙用——“使自己知情”，即主动获取信息（inform sb of/about sth 通知某人某事的自反版）| of 后接 what 引导的宾语从句：what is going on 正在发生的事（what 作从句主语）| remember to do 记得去做（防灾建议语体）| inform 课堂网络：keep sb informed 随时向某人通报、an informed decision 有依据的决定、informative 提供有用信息的 | 灾难自救建议的核心句：信息就是生存资源——短句大道理
pattern: Remember to inform yourself of + what-从句
imitationCn: 记得随时了解天气的最新变化。
imitationHint: Remember to inform yourself of → the latest changes in the weather（或 what the weather is doing）
imitationAnswer: Remember to inform yourself of the latest changes in the weather.

sentence: It took the form of a huge tree: the trunk, blackness, the branches, fire!
translation: 它呈现出一棵巨树的形状：树干，是黑暗；树枝，是烈火！
analysis: 庞贝火山云的千古名句（小普林尼书信）| take the form of 呈现……的形状/形式（课堂拓展：in the form of 以……形式、take form 逐渐成形）| 冒号后四个名词裸列：the trunk, blackness, the branches, fire——省略全部谓语（= the trunk was blackness, the branches were fire），名词对名词直接撞击，电报式的极限压缩 | 隐喻结构：具体（树干/树枝）配抽象（黑暗/烈火），一冒号两逗号一叹号完成一幅末日画 | 描写灾难奇观时“以熟喻怪”（像一棵树）再“以怪破熟”（树是黑与火）——读后续写场面描写的顶级技法
pattern: It took the form of + N: the N₁, N₂, the N₃, N₄!（名词对举省略）
imitationCn: 它呈现出一条巨龙的形状：龙身，是乌云；龙鳞，是闪电！
imitationHint: It took the form of a huge dragon: → the body, dark clouds, the scales, lightning!（名词裸列+感叹号）
imitationAnswer: It took the form of a huge dragon: the body, dark clouds, the scales, lightning!

sentence: The cries of women broke out; the men looked at each other, but were silent.
translation: 女人们的哭喊骤然爆发；男人们面面相觑，沉默不语。
analysis: break out 突然爆发（战争/火灾/哭喊等不好的事骤发；不及物、无被动——课堂 break 短语群：break down 崩溃/分解、break up 解体、break through 突破）| 分号并置两幅画面：哭喊的（有声）与沉默的（无声）——不写“大家很害怕”，让声音与沉默自己说话，show-don't-tell 的典范 | looked at each other, but were silent：并列谓语间的 but——对视本该交流，却无话可说，绝望尽在 but 里 | 古典书信体的克制笔法：句短、词朴、力重
pattern: The N of + sb + broke out; S + V-ed, but + were + adj.
imitationCn: 孩子们的欢呼骤然爆发；老兵们相视一笑，却红了眼眶。
imitationHint: The cheers of the children broke out; → the veterans smiled at each other, but had tears in their eyes（分号+对照）
imitationAnswer: The cheers of the children broke out; the veterans smiled at each other, but had tears in their eyes.

sentence: At the moment, they felt the earth shaking beneath their feet; beyond in the distance, they heard the crash of falling roofs.
translation: 那一刻，他们感到大地在脚下颤抖；在更远的远方，他们听到屋顶坍塌的轰响。
analysis: felt the earth shaking：感官动词 feel + 宾语 + 现在分词（正在颤抖）——与必修二 U3 的 see... standing / notice... fly by 补全感官动词宾补拼图 | 分号平衡两个分句：felt（触觉/脚下）对 heard（听觉/远方）——由近及远、由触到听的空间调度 | beyond in the distance 双重远指（beyond 更远处 + in the distance 在远方）| the crash of falling roofs：crash 巨响 + falling 现在分词作定语 | beneath their feet 在脚下（beneath 比 under 更书面）| 灾难现场的多感官描写模板
pattern: S + felt + N + V-ing + 方位; 方位, S + heard + the N + of + V-ing + N
imitationCn: 那一刻，他们感到桥面在脚下摇晃；在下游远处，他们听到洪水撞击堤坝的闷响。
imitationHint: At the moment, they felt the bridge swaying beneath their feet; → far downstream, they heard the thud of floodwater hitting the dam
imitationAnswer: At the moment, they felt the bridge swaying beneath their feet; far downstream, they heard the thud of floodwater hitting the dam.

sentence: We can't do that, otherwise the moving water could wash the car away!
translation: 我们不能那样做，否则流动的洪水会把车冲走的！
analysis: otherwise 否则（= if we did that...）——副词衔接暗含虚拟条件：后句 could wash 用 could 呼应“未发生的假设后果”，与必修二 U2 的 without a partner 含蓄虚拟同族 | wash away 冲走（wash sth away / wash away sth；代词须居中 wash it away）| the moving water：moving 现在分词作定语“流动的” | otherwise 课堂三义：否则（本句）/ 除此之外（Otherwise the house was silent.）/ 以其他方式（known as the Iron Hammer, otherwise...）| 洪水自救对话的关键句：车内被困时“弃车”与“留守”的抉择理由
pattern: S + can't do that, otherwise + S + could + V + O + away!
imitationCn: 我们不能停在这里，否则后面的车流会把我们困住的！
imitationHint: We can't stop here, otherwise the traffic behind → could trap us（otherwise + could 虚拟后果）
imitationAnswer: We can't stop here, otherwise the traffic behind could trap us!
